source: plexscratch (PMS 1.43.4) 2026-10-14: a probe movie library at /config/probe-media/movies (writable) and the copy's own Movies at /data/movies (a read-only mount). DELETE /library/metadata/{id} with the server token, then GET of the item and a listing of its folder. Plex's log for the first: 'Deleting directory [Qzxv Delete Probe (2001)]'.

cases.file_after: gone, and its now-empty folder with it

cases.what: allowMediaDeletion=1, the file not deletable (read-only mount)

reading: A media delete removes the file first; the row goes only when the file did. A file that cannot be removed leaves the row as it was and answers 400; with deletion off the answer is 403.
